instruction: Export a LibreOffice Draw diagram as an animated GIF using the built-in animation wizard, then apply it as a rotating desktop wallpaper.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Draw does not have an animation export wizard or the ability to create animated GIFs from diagrams. Additionally, while static wallpapers can be set, animated GIF wallpapers with automatic rotation are not standard desktop environment features without third-party tools. This follows the pattern of attempting an unsupported export followed by a secondary system-level operation.

Secondary requirement (animated GIF wallpaper with automatic rotation) is also correctly identified as not natively supported
